Θεογονία

Theogony

Ἡσίοδος Hesiod · c. 700 BC · 1,022 lines · 110 temples cross-linked

Hesiod's Theogony is the foundational genealogy of the Greek gods: from Chaos, Gaia and Ouranos through the Titans to the reign of Zeus. Nearly every Olympian temple in the Pantheon traces its lineage to a passage of this poem.
